purpose: Research references only; not game assets or runtime bindings

screenshots.title: PC combat HUD and the right-side log
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: Party left, initiative top, selected-character controls below and log right. The repeated XP rows in this older image were consolidated in the later Patch 6 update.

screenshots.title: Explicit ranged attack and its tooltip
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: The selected weapon attack is named. Damage, range and cost live in the hover description; weapon controls sit next to the selected portrait.

screenshots.title: Upcasting: available ranks in a temporary selector
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: The temporary selector offers slot levels I–V, distinguishes spent slots and highlights the selected available rank.

screenshots.title: Hotbar icons: readable silhouettes and variant badges
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: Bright available symbols remain distinct against dark slots. Small plus badges signal additional choices; icon colour is not the only state cue.

screenshots.title: Resource indicators above the hotbar
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: Actions, bonus actions, class resources and spell slots have different shapes. Filled and spent slots remain distinguishable.

screenshots.title: Movement and attack preview in an actual dungeon
screenshots.note: The path, destination and attack preview are spatial. Dungeon architecture, lighting and props provide context without a permanent instruction panel.

screenshots.title: Opportunity-attack warning on a proposed move
screenshots.note: The red warning appears on the creature that threatens the route. It is a consequence preview beside the relevant world object.

screenshots.title: World labels for loot and containers
screenshots.note: Named labels sit over the world. Alt is the default item-label key; it is not a promise that every lever, door and decorative prop receives an item label.

screenshots.title: Door and threshold in a lit interior
screenshots.credit: ClutchPoints · Overgrown Ruins door guide · release-era PC screenshot
screenshots.note: A real dungeon threshold in its architectural and lighting context. This image demonstrates scene/UI composition, not the hover or opening state of the door.

screenshots.title: World-object context menu
screenshots.note: A small menu beside an object offers alternatives such as picking it up, attacking it and throwing it. This is a world interaction reference, not an inventory reference.

screenshots.title: Combat-log calculation details
screenshots.note: Inspect the calculation popup separately from the readable short log entries. We need the recorded dice and named modifiers; copying the log remains our own requirement.

screenshots.title: PC Magic Missile: projectile allocation controls
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: The targeting bar shows a remaining-projectile indicator and a confirmation control. Repeated and partial allocations follow the particular action.

screenshots.title: Reaction settings: automatic or ask
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: Reactions have separate enabled and Ask choices; they are not another set of permanently visible hotbar instructions.

screenshots.title: Spell description on demand
screenshots.credit: Combat for Beginners · Steam community guide · December 2023
screenshots.note: The temporary tooltip groups name, damage, description, save, range and resource cost. That detail is not repeated as permanent HUD text.
